resources.string: A few questions before you start

CoPlanly can hold your family\'s key details — a blood group, allergies, a grandparent\'s phone number — so that whoever is with your child can find their way quickly if something unexpected happens.\n\nAll of it is optional except your name, and you can fill it in later from Settings.
Kept for you and your co-parent, in case of an emergency.
Your name is the one thing the app needs — it labels every event and expense.
You can add medications, activities and school details later, from Settings.
A grandparent, an aunt, an uncle — anyone who might collect your child or be called in an emergency.
These contacts are saved with your child, so add your child first — go back a step, or add them later from Settings.
Set out which days your child is with each of you. You can change it at any time, and your co-parent has to agree to a change.
Send them a link or a code. Once they join, they will see everything you have filled in here and can add to it.
Pick both if that is your family. You can change this later in Settings.
Child records, contacts and school details
Pet records, vaccinations and the vet's number
Just a name and what kind. Vaccinations, feeding notes and the vet come later, on the pet's own screen.
